bio: Clayton Hotel Birmingham is a luxurious 4-star hotel in the heart of Birmingham City Centre, close to New Street and Moor Street railway stations.  Enjoy a Traditional Afternoon Tea menu, including fresh finger sandwiches, mini baguettes and a mini savoury patisserie. Warm baked scones are served with  jam & clotted cream, followed by a selection of petit four sweet treats. Your Afternoon Tea includes unlimited tea or coffee.  Upgrade you Traditional Afternoon Tea to include a glass of Prosecco or a mocktail.  Afternoon Tea is served every day from 1pm to 5pm and costs £23.95 per person, or £29.95 with a glass of Prosecco or mocktail.  A children’s Afternoon tea is also available for £12.95 per child.
